identity.name: Clone X
identity.notes: Sunset RTFKT collection. Official holder downloads are avatar-ready source 3D files delivered in GLB/FBX lanes; RTFKT separately teaches holders to convert those sources into VRM. The source library therefore qualifies for the broader usable-avatar inventory even though it is not a shipped per-token VRM inventory.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous report states Clone X drops Nov. 29, 2021.
OpenSea shows Dec 2021; retained as a month-boundary discrepancy.

storage.note: Clone X source 3D files are delivered through the authenticated Clone X holder surface; this is not a claim about a native VRM object-store backend.

evidence.note: RTFKT says current delivered formats are GLB or FBX.

vrm_inventory.note: RTFKT's official delivery docs identify GLB/FBX source files. VRM is a holder-created export using Clone Converter/Blender; no official per-token native VRM download inventory is shipped by the collection itself.

evidence.note: Delivered formats documented as GLB or FBX.
Clone Converter is documented as a tool to optimize/export a Clone as VRM.
Official course teaches holders how to create a Clone X VRM from source files.

avatar_formats.note: RTFKT documents Clone X as a high-end avatar collection ready for digital worlds, delivers the source library in GLB/FBX formats, provides posing and animation tooling that operates on Clone files, and documents user-friendly rigging/animation as part of the 3D asset-library requirements. This crosses the broader rigged-avatar threshold without implying that native VRM files were shipped.

evidence.note: Official Clone X 3D Files page describes the collection as high-end avatars ready for digital worlds and documents holder download access.

Official 3D Files 2.0 documentation identifies GLB/FBX delivery, says Clone X files remain downloadable from the dedicated Clone X inventory, and specifies user-friendly rigging and animation for the asset library.
Official Clone Tools operates on imported Clone files and provides one-click posing plus animation packs and export settings.

avatar_inventory.note: Clone X GLB/FBX avatar-ready files are proven to have shipped, but they are retrieved per owned Clone through a holder-gated surface. No exhaustive public asset URL lane has been recovered, so this remains incomplete rather than terminally complete.

evidence.note: Official instructions require connecting a wallet, selecting an owned Clone and downloading from its 3D Files tab.
Official update confirms GLB/FBX delivery and continued Clone X downloads from the holder inventory.

ip_rights.summary: RTFKT documents commercial rights for Clone X 3D files and requires holders to register their Clone for commercial-license use under the applicable 3D-model commercial-license guidelines.

evidence.note: Official documentation describes commercial rights and Clone registration for commercial licensing.

file_access.note: There is no official native VRM file to access. The underlying Clone X GLB/FBX source files are separately holder-gated and require wallet ownership; holders can convert those sources to VRM themselves.

evidence.note: Source 3D download requires connecting a wallet and selecting an owned Clone.

project_status.note: RTFKT announced its operational wind-down for the end of January 2025. Current archive/download resources are preservation surfaces, not evidence of an operating project.
